long_biography.plain_text:
Greenwood Technology began as Software Mechanix, building web-based applications for logistics, health, insurance and construction clients. By 2000, outside investors had taken a minority stake to fund staff growth and regional expansion, reflecting the ambition behind Simon Greenwood's early enterprise-software work.

NextMinute returned him to a founder role in 2016. Its job-management platform brought quoting, scheduling, invoicing and cashflow tools together for construction trades, growing to serve thousands of users across New Zealand and Australia. The product is designed to move essential administration away from evenings and weekends into one operational system.
